name: Sunray Solace 200SH | 2-Person Traditional Barrel Sauna
description: Description The SunRay Solace 2-Person Barrel Sauna is designed for relaxation and durability. Measuring 6' x 4', it fits comfortably in most backyards or larger indoor spaces. Constructed from solid red cedar with ball-and-socket joinery and stainless steel hardware, it is built to withstand regular use and outdoor conditions. The powerful 6.0 kW Harvia electric heater heats up quickly, reaching 170–180°F, and includes a delay timer that allows scheduling up to 8 hours in advance. Standard features include a shingled roof, flat floor leveling kit, interior dome lighting, tempered glass door, and a complete accessory set with bucket, ladle, thermo-hygrometer, sand timer, and heater stones. Features Seats 2 people 6.0 kW Harvia electric heater with sauna stones Heats up to 170–180°F Built-in 8-hour delay start timer Ball-and-socket red cedar wood construction (1 3/8" thick lumber) Stainless steel hardware Shingled roof for outdoor durability Flat floor leveling kit included Interior dome lighting (no extra circuit required) Tempered glass door Accessory kit: bucket, ladle, thermo-hygrometer, sand timer, heater stones Weather-resistant support cradles Easy to assemble 7-Year Limited Warranty For indoor or outdoor use What's Included?
